about.title: About Play! Pokémon Prize Pack
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Play! Pokémon Prize Pack came out on 1 July 2026 and has 849 cards. Prize Pack cards are reprints with the Play! Pokémon stamp, given out at events. TCGplayer lists all the series together, so they are in one list here.

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
